primary_estimand: Exercise response: change from baseline (BL) within each diet group at H0 and at H2 (S2.3.p1, S2.3.p6, S5.6.p3); diet differences at each time point are a secondary, associational estimand (S2.2.p1) and are not the requested exercise question.
paper_method: mixed-effect ANOVA (car, R 3.0) + Tukey post-hoc, BH FDR (S5.6.p3)
matrix_scale: RPKM (easyRNASeq), filtered at 50 mapped reads; values < 10 reads replaced by the RPKM equivalent of 10 reads (S5.6.p2)

reported_counts.HC_only_vs_BL: 330 genes 'differentially expressed vs. baseline in HC only' (S2.3.p2; time point not stated, read with FIG4)
reported_counts.LC_H0_vs_BL: 161 genes 'different at H0 vs. baseline in LC' (S2.3.p2; unclear whether total or LC-unique)
reported_counts.shared_H0: 198 genes DE at H0 irrespective of diet (both HC and LC) (S2.3.p3)
reported_counts.shared_H2: 100 DEGs shared between diets at H2 (S2.3.p6)
reported_counts.direction: up/down split not reported in text (only in FIG4 bars)
